verdict.rationale: Copilot Chat, agent mode, and CLI support natural-language commands across IDEs, terminal, and web/desktop workspaces, letting users direct edits, task execution, and reviews via NL prompts; hands-on community reports (though mixed on productivity) confirm real chat/agent usage. Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of NL command reliability across all surfaces and clearer evidence of voice/other NL modalities beyond text chat.
